name: Yuu
source:
An old childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuuki[/url] but he partially remembers him. He has forgotten all the "details" about him.

He remembered that he loved him a lot and that he loved playing with him and climbing trees.
translation:
An old childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]Yuuki[/url] but he partially remembers him. He has forgotten all the "details" about him.

He remembered that he loved him a lot and that he loved playing with him and climbing trees.
